title: Associated Bank finalizes $8.8M loan for boutique rental community in Grafton, Wisconsin
summary: Associated Bank announced the completion of a $8,846,600 loan to Cirrus Property Group for construction of The Carillon at Grafton, a boutique rental community.
body_markdown: Associated Bank announced the completion of a $8,846,600 loan to Cirrus Property Group for construction of The Carillon at Grafton, a boutique rental community.
